description: NVIDIA backend command encoding and explicit software/driver protocol pairing. Physical GPU ownership remains in NVIDIA.R4D.

functions.name: negotiate

operation.ownership: Pure encoding into caller-owned output. No allocation, hardware access or retained pointers.

functions.description: Validates a driver-supplied profile; reported features describe encoding support, not physical qualification.

functions.name: encode_copy

operation.ownership: Pure encoding into caller-owned output. No allocation, hardware access or retained pointers.

functions.description: Encodes virtual CE copies and system-scope semaphore release. Validation precedes every output write.

functions.name: encode_copy_layout

operation.ownership: Pure encoding into caller-owned output. No allocation, hardware access or retained pointers.

functions.description: Encodes pitch/blocklinear conversion through C6B5/C7B5, bounded by max_layout_command_words. Original encode_copy and its limits remain available. No retained state or device access.

functions.name: image_layout

operation.ownership: Pure metadata negotiation; no allocation, maps, hardware access or retained pointers.

functions.description: Checks known C797/SM86 image layouts against texture/render/scanout use. Suggests an explicit compatible CE conversion for known readable views; never guesses an unknown modifier.

functions.name: shader_info

operation.ownership: Bounded pure operation over caller-owned storage. No allocation, I/O, GPU access, retained pointer or compilation. Rejection preserves all outputs.

functions.description: Returns metadata for a pinned fixed shader, including the matched solid vertex/fragment pair, without publishing rendering capability.

functions.name: shader_cache_write

operation.ownership: Bounded pure operation over caller-owned storage. No allocation, I/O, GPU access, retained pointer or compilation. Rejection preserves all outputs.

functions.description: Writes the checked key, compiler identity, original NVIDIA header and machine code with an integrity digest. No compiler work or hardware submission. Output bytes, written count and key must not overlap.

functions.name: shader_cache_read

operation.ownership: Bounded pure operation over caller-owned storage. No allocation, I/O, GPU access, retained pointer or compilation. Rejection preserves all outputs.

functions.description: Returns a view only after exact key/compiler/layout/length/integrity and fixed-program matching. Incompatible or damaged cache data returns CACHE_MISS with output unchanged. The input key must come from the current driver/renderer, not the cached entry.

interfaces.description: Independent fixed-shader metadata and executable byte-cache boundary. BACKEND_V1 remains unchanged; native rendering, GPU memory and compilation are separate owners.

types.name: R4NvDeviceProfile
types.description: Exact live driver binding plus its pinned command/firmware profile.

types.name: R4NvFeatures
types.description: Actual encoder limits; no rendering or hardware validation claim.

types.name: R4NvCopy
types.description: GPU virtual operands supplied by the owning driver. Zero rows denotes a linear transfer; otherwise bytes per row.

types.name: R4NvDriverProfile
types.description: Immutable driver protocol payload in GfxBackendProfile.data. Version 1, size 32, vendor 0x10de and actual allocated copy-engine class; reserved fields zero. Identity/revision are BACKEND_V1. Kernel-assigned adapter and generations come from the accompanying binding, never these bytes.

types.name: R4NvCopyBlock
types.description: Optional 2D blocklinear plane. enabled is zero or one; all other fields zero when disabled. Width/pitch and x are bytes with remapping disabled; height/y are rows. 512-byte GOBs, one GOB wide, log2_gobs 0..5, depth one, no compression.

types.name: R4NvCopyLayout
types.description: Independent copy-layout request; original R4NvCopy remains unchanged. Block operands are plane-base addresses aligned to 512; pitched operands already include logical x/y offsets. Both full plane spans and all transfer bounds must fit; aliases are rejected before command writes.

types.name: R4NvDigest
types.description: 32-byte identity; each word is the little-endian value of eight consecutive digest bytes. No pointer or padding.

types.name: R4NvShaderKey
types.description: Version1 exact-size key from the actual driver/renderer. Nonzero artifact-version token, device identity, input/output format and complete pipeline-state digest. Only SM86/AMPERE_B is supported. Keys contain no GPU addresses or live resource handles; GPU allocations still require current-generation binding by the renderer.

types.name: R4NvShaderInfo
types.description: Fixed shader metadata and source/toolchain identity. Stage0 is vertex; stage4 is fragment. Header is128 little-endian bytes; code is SM86 machine code. Encoding support is not GPU qualification.

types.name: R4NvShaderView
types.description: Borrowed byte ranges inside the caller-owned immutable cache input. Keep that storage alive until the renderer has copied/uploaded both ranges. Addresses have byte alignment and must not be cast to aligned u32 pointers without checking. No pointer is retained by the library.

types.name: R4NvImageView
types.description: Single-plane image metadata, no CPU/GPU address. Location0=system,1=device-local; modifier0=linear. Runtime must authenticate ownership/generations and physical mapping.

types.name: R4NvImageRequest
types.description: Prepare an image for texture1/render-target2/scanout4. Preference0=preserve suitable layout,1=linear,2=blocklinear; flags1 forces a separate copy. Render+scanout requires the later inactive-image lease and is unsupported here.

types.name: R4NvImagePlan
types.description: Action0=reuse,1=convert through CE; layout0=linear,1=blocklinear. Unknown/undecodable modifiers fail without a plan. Proposed bytes include the pinned native64KB allocation granule; no allocation or GPU qualification occurs here.

constants.description: Graphics constants ABI4 preserves CBuf1 texture handle/bounds/logical grid and adds the fixed color fragment CBuf2 with256 bytes of userland-supplied matrices, transfer/range/white/tone coefficients. Earlier resource keys are unsupported; existing table and payload layouts remain unchanged.
Maximum serialized fixed-shader cache entry:16KB, including the384-byte cache header. Caller supplies and retains the actual buffer capacity; short buffers are rejected before writes.
Solid rectangle vertex shader with position/tint outputs matching the solid fragment shader.
Fixed RGB color transform: sRGB/linear/PQ/HLG, two matrices, explicit range/alpha, white scaling, optional output tone/gamut mapping and ordered dither; CBuf2 ABI4.

errors.description: Incompatible or damaged executable cache; discard it and rebuild from the current fixed program. Output remains unchanged.

ownership_rules.name: hardware
ownership_rules.text: The library creates command words only. NVIDIA.R4D validates mappings, current generation, channel state and completion; only that driver submits or frees GPU resources.

ownership_rules.name: outputs
ownership_rules.text: Inputs are immutable for the call. Output commands and written count must be separate from each other and request metadata. Rejection leaves both outputs unchanged.

ownership_rules.name: version
ownership_rules.text: BACKEND_V1 is independent of R4GFX and the platform ABI. Optional consumers validate the library header and negotiate the actual driver profile; absent/incompatible backends keep software available.

ownership_rules.name: shader_cache
ownership_rules.text: Immutable byte caches bind exact driver/GPU/compiler/ABI/format/pipeline identities. No executable GPU address survives in a cache. Renderer-owned native shader/pipeline allocations must be recreated or validated after device/reset generation changes.
